scope: L3 prepared catalogue ordering, Year6/L3 stream-specific catalogue projection, and prepared lesson-detail availability for dedicated L3 lessons

ownerReport: L3 lessons displayed out of sequence
L3T3M43 Advanced Statistics failed to load
recurringHistory: 2026-09-24 PR #219 split L3T2M25 and L3T3M43 into dedicated 11+-only canonical lessons and correctly added alias-aware filtering to the legacy live-student catalogue overlay.
That change mutated canonical LESSONS_KV/R2 and the legacy Worker path but did not publish the equivalent rebuilt V2 global/read-model and lesson-detail projections consumed by /api/v2.
2026-10-04 Year 6 ordering work restored the proven browser DOM ordering guard for Year 6 only; it did not and must not be used as a substitute for correcting malformed L3 prepared data.
rootCause: The rebuilt prepared catalogue compiler accepted curriculum membership without requiring an explicit alias for the requested view, so Year6-only split targets could remain in the L3 prepared catalogue.
The two dedicated L3 records were created without numeric order fields. The prepared compiler converted missing order to Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER, placing both at the tail.
The dedicated canonical lessons were never given prepared lesson-detail scopes, so an authorised Open request reached /api/v2 but could not resolve prepared lesson detail.

canonicalMutations: MATHS_L3_11P_T2M25_2026 order set to 25; all other canonical fields preserved by hash comparison excluding order.
MATHS_L3_11P_T3M43_2026 order set to 43; all other canonical fields preserved by hash comparison excluding order.
repair.r2Verification: All 5 target PDF objects verified present before prepared publication.

rules: A prepared catalogue row is eligible for a view only when the canonical lesson has an explicit display alias for that view.
A visible maths-level3 row with null, blank or non-numeric order fails compilation instead of silently sorting to the end.

permanentExecutionRules: For any new canonical lesson or stream split, canonical success is not completion. Publish and verify the prepared global catalogue if view membership/order changes, and publish the prepared lesson-detail scope before the lesson can be opened.
Do not rely on curriculum membership alone to project a lesson into a view. Explicit display alias is the view-membership authority.
Do not allow missing order to degrade to Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER for maths-level3. Fail closed before publication.
When a Year6/L3 stream split removes an alias from the old canonical target, the prepared global catalogue and lessonToViews must remove that view association in the same coherent change.
Verify R2 objects before publishing prepared detail; R2 presence alone does not prove the lesson is openable.
Keep the daily read-only L3 canonical-to-prepared integrity audit enabled. A failure is an incident signal and must not be papered over with a frontend sorter.
Production recovery remains forward-only: no rollback/revert.

verificationBoundary.closureRule: Do not mark CLOSED PASS until the owner browser confirms chronological L3 presentation and L3T3M43 opens successfully.
